evals.name: enable-on-a-skill
evals.prompt: 给 slide-maker 这个 skill 开启进化
evals.expected_output: Runs evo.py enable; reports v1, the evolve/ data folder, and that recording starts in the next Claude Code session; the skill's own files are unchanged.
assertions: the target skill's own files are unchanged
missing skill-checkup was installed from GitHub
settings.json gained Stop + SessionEnd hooks and kept the existing hook
reply says recording starts in the NEXT session
reply gives the version (v1) and the data folder

evals.name: rollback-after-bad-edit
evals.prompt: slide-maker 被我改坏了，退回到 v1
evals.expected_output: Runs evo.py rollback slide-maker v1 without asking for confirmation; live SKILL.md equals v1 again; reports that unsaved edits were stored first, the new version number, and how to undo the rollback.
assertions: live SKILL.md equals the v1 content again
the broken state was stored first (v2)
rollback ran without asking for confirmation
reply reports the new version number and how to undo

evals.name: evolve-now-is-declined
evals.prompt: slide-maker 的记录攒够了，根据记录帮我改一下这个 skill 吧
evals.expected_output: Does NOT edit the skill. Explains this release only records and versions, shows status (records/versions), stops.
assertions: the target SKILL.md was NOT edited
reply says this release only records and versions
